title: Every point of a locally Noetherian scheme has a closed specialization
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. For every point $x\in X$ there is a point $c\in X$ such that $\{c\}$ is closed in the underlying topological space of $X$ and $c\in\overline{\{x\}}$. Thus $x$ specializes to a point closed in $X$, not merely in an affine open neighbourhood. The statement allows the empty scheme, when the assertion for every $x$ is vacuous.
